function.name: bash
function.arguments: {"command": "cd ~/data; awk -F, 'NR>1{print NF}' sales_2026.csv|sort|uniq -c; awk -F, 'NR>1{print $2}' sales_2026.csv|sort|uniq -c; awk -F, 'NR>1 && ($5!~/^-?[0-9]+$/ || $6!~/^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$/ || $5<=0 || $6<=0)' sales_2026.csv|head -20; grep -c $'\\r' sales_2026.csv; sort sales_2026.csv|uniq -d|head"}

function.name: bash
function.arguments: {"command": "mkdir -p ~/out; cd ~/out; (echo region,revenue; awk -F, 'NR>1{r[$2]+=$5*$6}END{for(k in r)printf \"%s,%.2f\\n\",k,r[k]}' ~/data/sales_2026.csv|sort -t, -k2,2nr) > region_totals.csv; cat region_totals.csv"}
